rules.label: Hospital Discounted Care for uninsured or underinsured patients at or below 250% FPL
rules.quote: Patients who are at or below 250% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines (FPG) are eligible for Hospital Discounted Care.

rules.label: Internal charity care for outpatient services based on income and family size
rules.quote: Eligibility shall be based solely on the total gross family income adjusted for family size and is only applicable to outpatient services.

notes: Hospital Discounted Care payment plans cannot exceed 4% of gross monthly income for hospital bills and 2% for separate provider bills, with a maximum of 36 months.
Internal charity care requires exhaustion of third-party payment sources, may require Medicaid application, and has a 45-day deadline for financial information submission.
Charity approval affects accounts within 6 months of application date, with possible discretionary review beyond 6 months.
AccessOne offers 0% interest payment plans with no fees, combining bills into a single monthly payment.
Internal payment plans are available up to 12 months with a minimum $25 monthly payment.
hdc_uninsured_underinsured may leave out a condition: adds co_resident condition not in quote; policy requires Colorado residency for HDC

dropped.claim: The policy's deadline for a patient to SUBMIT a financial-assistance application is 45 days after the date of service (alone, or as one of several 'the later of' options)
dropped.quote: If financial information is not provided to support a completed application for charity assistance within 45 days, it will be considered denied.
